## About
R & L Muffler Shop Inc is a family-owned-and-operated automotive shop on Drew Street in Clearwater. We specialize in competitively priced exhaust work, along with converter services, muffler repair or replacement, tire and brake services, and affordable front-end parts.
We work on personal, commercial and industrial vehicles: domestic and foreign cars, motorhomes, vintage and antique cars, and light-duty trucks on up. Makes we see include Mercedes, BMW, Acura, Toyota, GM, Chevrolet, Dodge and Chrysler.
Our customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 306 Google reviews. One reviewer called us the best muffler and exhaust shop in Pinellas County.

## Services
- Exhaust Work: Diagnosis, repairs, replacements and custom exhaust services for your car or truck.
- Muffler repair or replacement: Fixing or swapping out a worn muffler at a fair price.
- Catalytic Converters & Brakes: Brake and catalytic converter services for cars and trucks.
- Brake services for industrial freight and light-duty trucks: We have the resources to handle brakes on bigger work vehicles too.
- Tire and brake services: Tire and brake work alongside your exhaust repairs.
- Front-end parts: Affordable front-end parts from our shop.
- Free Exhaust Brake Inspection: Ask us to take a look at your exhaust brake at no charge. (Free)

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Free estimates and inspections are available. You can call us or fill out the estimate form on our site.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Domestic and foreign vehicles, motorhomes, vintage and antique cars, and trucks from light-duty to one-ton.

Q: How do I find the shop?
A: Look for our yellow building next door to Window Tint America and behind Bobby J's Auto Sales, on the corner of Drew Street and N Main Avenue.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.
